## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete need and the behavior or documentation changed.

## Scope

Identify the authorized module or repository-preparation task. List any remaining limitations.

## Architecture and workflow checks

- [ ] One application/repository, authoritative Project ID and integrated database architecture remain intact.
- [ ] Common authentication/RBAC, documents, workflow, audit and API services are reused.
- [ ] The official lifecycle and both ordered review hierarchies remain intact.
- [ ] Recommendations, Director-General decisions and Certification Unit issuance remain distinct.
- [ ] PPA verifies clearance only; MoF verifies clearance and certificates; both remain read-only.
- [ ] Server-side role/institution/project scope and evidence-version rules are preserved where applicable.
- [ ] No capability outside the requested scope is implemented.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data or operational case evidence are committed.
- [ ] Relevant architecture/workflow documentation and ADRs are updated.

## Validation

State the checks actually performed and their results. For documentation-only changes, report consistency, link and scope validation. Mark non-applicable runtime checks clearly; do not claim unperformed tests.
